title: Relational Betrayal Trauma
cardText: For those reeling from a partner's infidelity, secret life, or broken trust — the discovery and everything after.
whatThisFeelsLike: [DRAFT — Matthew to rewrite in his own words] You found out, and now you can't stop replaying it. The person you trusted most became the person who hurt you most, and nobody around you understands what that does to a mind and body.
howWeWork: Betrayal trauma is treated here as trauma — not as a marriage problem to referee. Using CBT and Emotionally Focused Therapy (EFT), sessions focus first on stabilizing you: making sense of intrusive thoughts, hypervigilance, and grief that arrive after discovery. Whether the relationship continues is your decision, made in your time; the work is about your healing either way. Sessions are available individually, in person in West Chester or by telehealth anywhere in Ohio.
